evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Chinese University of Hong Kong)
evidence.text: Analyzes 店 as 从广、占声 and gives its basic sense as a storehouse for placing goods. It cites the Jin-period 古今注 explanation contrasting 肆, where goods are displayed for sale, with 店, where goods are kept; it also quotes 唐律疏議 distinguishing storage (邸) from selling (店), and a Tang poem using 店 for an inn.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫: 店

evidence.text: Analyzes 店 as a phonosemantic compound, 广 as meaning component and 占 as sound component. It gives modern Mandarin 店 diàn and 占 zhàn/zhān, and compares Baxter–Sagart Old Chinese 店 /*tˤem-s/ and 占 /*tem/. This supports a phonetic relationship in the compound, not the claim that 店 was borrowed wholesale for another word.
evidence.title: 店 - Dong Chinese dictionary

evidence.source: Wiktionary, citing Zhengzhang Shangfang (2003) and Baxter–Sagart (2014)
evidence.text: Reports Zhengzhang Old Chinese 店 /*tiːms/ and 占 /*tjems/ in the relevant departing-tone readings, and Baxter–Sagart 店 /*tˤem-s/ and 占 /*tem/. These reconstructions are from separate systems and should not be directly mixed; within each system the shared onset/rime and related departing-tone form support 占 as phonetic. Modern Mandarin readings are 店 diàn and 占 zhàn/zhān. The page gives no basis for dating the graph’s formation.
evidence.title: 店 - Wiktionary, the free dictionary

evidence.source: Wiktionary entry for 占, reporting Zhengzhang (2003) and Baxter–Sagart (2014)
evidence.text: Lists 占 with Old Chinese /*ʔljem/ in Zhengzhang’s system and /*tem/ in Baxter–Sagart’s system for the prognosticate reading; its other reading is separately represented as Zhengzhang /*tjems/ and Baxter–Sagart /*tem/ in the phonetic series material. Because 占 has multiple readings, phonetic comparison must use the reading compatible with 店, rather than its first-listed reading alone.
evidence.title: 占 - 维基词典，自由的多语言词典

evidence.source: Wiktionary, reporting Zhengzhang Shangfang (2003) and Baxter–Sagart (2014)
evidence.text: Lists 占 as a phonetic-series component for 店. For 店, Zhengzhang gives /*tiːms/ (侵 rhyme group); Baxter–Sagart gives /*tˤem-s/. For 占, the relevant departing-tone comparison is Zhengzhang /*tjems/ and Baxter–Sagart /*tem/. These are reconstructions, not direct sound recordings; source-word identity and original pronunciation of 占’s depicted components do not determine its later use as a phonetic element.

gaps: No visually inspected paleographic glyph sequence for 店 was available; earliest graph form, dated script stages, and any graphic change or corruption remain unestablished.

The cited Jin-period 古今注 provides an early historical lexical gloss, but its transmitted-text page could not be opened in this session and the exact textual witness/date of the quoted passage was not verified independently.

No secure pre-Jin attestation was established here. The quoted sources support storage, selling-place, and inn uses by the cited periods, but do not justify inferring a precise semantic chronology beyond those separate attestations.
The account of 店 as 广 semantic plus 占 phonetic is supported by CUHK and Dong Chinese; no competing scholarly graphic analysis was located in the inspected sources.

No whole-graph phonetic-loan proposal was found for 店. 占 is supported as a phonetic component within 店; questions about the ancient referent or pronunciation of the depicted forms of 广 or 占 do not by themselves negate that component role.

Historical pronunciation values are reconstruction-specific: Zhengzhang 2003 and Baxter–Sagart 2014 forms are distinct models. The entries establish compatible comparisons, not a uniquely recoverable pronunciation or exact date for compound formation.
The Tang poem and legal quotation are cited by CUHK as attestations, but precise composition dates and earliest-use priority were not established.
